new.name: FORMALIZES_CONSTRAINTS_AS_CHECKABLE_CONDITIONS
new.definition: The reasoning converts informally stated requirements into explicit, mechanically checkable conditions, such as numeric bounds, inequality ranges, or exclusion intervals, against which candidate solutions can be tested.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text restating requirements as testable conditions or admissible ranges.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning derives at least one explicit checkable condition (e.g., an inequality bound or excluded interval) from the stated requirements.
The derived condition is expressed precisely enough to accept or reject a candidate solution.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only repeats the original requirement wording without converting it into a testable condition.
The reasoning lists preferences or observations without deriving any admissibility condition.

new.name: SELECTS_CANDIDATE_BY_CONSTRAINT_ELIMINATION
new.definition: The reasoning evaluates an ordered set of candidate options, explicitly discards candidates that violate hard requirements, and identifies the surviving candidate as the chosen outcome, optionally applying soft preferences only among survivors.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text enumerating candidates, rejecting violating ones, and naming the selected option.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning considers more than one candidate option.
At least one candidate is rejected with an explicit reason tied to a hard requirement.
A surviving candidate is identified as the selected outcome.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning asserts a chosen option without evaluating any alternative.
The reasoning enumerates candidates but never reaches a selection.

new.name: DERIVES_CONSTRAINT_INPUTS_FROM_OBSERVED_RECORDS
new.definition: The reasoning extracts concrete values from the content of an observation and uses them to compute constraint-relevant quantities (such as occupied intervals or available ranges) that later constrain the solution.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text computing constraint-relevant quantities from observed records.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: Observation whose content supplies the underlying records or values.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning cites or transforms specific content present in the observation.
The derived quantities are used as constraints or inputs to the solution process.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning discusses the observation only in general terms without extracting concrete values.
The observation's content is not used in the derived quantities.

new.name: DETECTS_OBSERVED_DATA_INCONSISTENCY
new.definition: The reasoning identifies an explicit discrepancy between the observed content and what its labeling, structure, or context led the agent to expect, and states that discrepancy as a finding.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text naming the mismatch between observed content and expectation.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: Observation whose content contains the unexpected or inconsistent element.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states what was expected and what was actually observed.
The inconsistency is attributable to identifiable content in the observation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only summarizes the observation without comparing it to an expectation.
The mismatch is claimed between two reasoning statements rather than traced to the observation's content.

new.name: CONFIRMS_PREDICTED_OUTCOME
new.definition: The reasoning states a specific anticipated result, and a later observation reports a result matching that anticipation, thereby corroborating the agent's prediction.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text stating a specific expected value, verdict, or outcome.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: Observation reporting a result that can be compared to the stated expectation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names a concrete expected outcome, not merely a procedure.
The observation reports a result that matches that expected outcome.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports a result contradicting the stated expectation.
The reasoning describes a procedure without predicting any outcome.
The observation's content is unrelated to the stated expectation.

new.name: CHECKS_INPUT_INTEGRITY_WITHOUT_MODIFICATION
new.definition: The reasoning expresses the goal of confirming that read-only inputs are unaltered, a non-mutating inspection action is performed for that purpose, and the resulting observation reports evidence about whether the inputs remain unchanged.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text expressing the intention to confirm inputs were not modified.

parameters.name: inspection_action
parameters.description: Non-mutating action (listing, checksum, or read) applied to the input artifacts.

parameters.name: inspection_result
parameters.description: Observation reporting file metadata, checksums, or contents relevant to input integrity.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states that preserving or confirming the unmodified state of the inputs is the purpose of the check.
The action does not write to or otherwise alter the inspected inputs.
The observation reports state information that bears on whether the inputs are unchanged.
exclusion_conditions: The action modifies the inspected inputs.
The inspection serves solution production rather than confirming input integrity.
No observation reports the inspection's outcome.

uncertain.name: REMEDIATES_DIAGNOSED_FAILURE
uncertain.definition: A failure observation, a diagnostic explanation of its cause, and a corrective action jointly form a remediation step in which the action alters the procedure or artifact so that the diagnosed cause is removed.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: Observation reporting the failing outcome that motivates remediation.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: Reasoning that identifies the specific cause of the reported failure.

parameters.name: corrective_action
parameters.description: Action that modifies the procedure or artifact to eliminate the diagnosed cause.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a failure consistent with the cause named in the diagnosis reasoning.
The corrective action changes the element identified in the diagnosis (logic, value, or structure) rather than repeating the failed operation unchanged.
exclusion_conditions: The action repeats the failed operation without modification.
No failure observation or no causal diagnosis is present.
The action targets something other than the diagnosed cause.
